name: sigma
blurb: A self-reliant "lone wolf" type of man; for Gen Alpha, a jokey word for cool or impressive
title: Sigma Meaning: What Does Sigma Mean in Slang?
description: Sigma, from "sigma male", means a cool, independent lone-wolf type. Coined in a 2010 blog post, it went viral in 2021 and became Gen Alpha slang for cool.
h1: What does sigma mean in slang?
answer: In slang, sigma means someone who is cool, independent and successful on their own terms, a "lone wolf" who does not need anyone's approval. It comes from "sigma male", a label coined in a 2010 blog post as an alternative to the "alpha male", which went viral and was widely mocked in January 2021. By 2023 kids were using "sigma" loosely to mean "cool" or simply as a funny word, often ironically, in phrases like "what the sigma".

body: The original idea comes from pop-psychology rankings of men as "alpha", "beta" and so on. The "sigma" was described as equal to the alpha but outside the hierarchy: quiet, self-sufficient, mysterious. Critics have called the whole system made up, and much of the internet adopted the term mainly to make fun of it.
Among younger kids today, sigma is mostly a compliment that means "cool", "based" or "impressive", or a nonsense word said for the laugh. Many who use it have never heard of the original theory.

head: Date
Event
rows: An American blogger publishes the post usually credited with coining "sigma male".
Videos explaining the "sigma male" spread on YouTube.
A tweet resurfacing the original "sigma" diagrams goes viral and the concept is widely mocked.
Ironic "sigma grindset" videos built on clips of Patrick Bateman from American Psycho become a popular format.
The "sigma face", an exhale followed by a strained smile copied from Bateman, goes viral on TikTok.
#sigma passes 46 billion TikTok views in 2023; in 2024 the Russian pop song "Sigma Boy" goes viral.

ul: "He walked out of the exam after ten minutes with full marks. Sigma."
"What the sigma?" (a silly way to say "what the heck?")
"Sigma grindset": jokingly praising extreme hustle, as in "Rule 1: sleep is for the weak".
Doing the sigma face: a little exhale and a tight, knowing smile.

body: Today sigma is mostly ironic. When kids say it, it is playful brainrot-style slang. When adults use "sigma male" seriously, it usually comes from self-help or "manosphere" content about masculinity, which many people find silly or off-putting. Context decides which one you are hearing.

faq.a: An internet label for a man pictured as a confident, independent lone wolf, said to be equal to an "alpha" but outside social hierarchies. It is not a scientific category.
A deliberately silly version of "what the heck?", popular with Gen Alpha. It has no deeper meaning.

faq.q: Why is Patrick Bateman linked to sigma?
faq.a: Christian Bale's character in American Psycho (2000) became the joke mascot of the "sigma grindset" memes, and his expression inspired the "sigma face".
